D1.rationale: No per-tool-call agent-run record is described; executor emits completion text only, not a call log.

D2.rationale: No run-record signature or deterministic replay is specified; ed25519 verifies federation agents, not records.

D3.rationale: No sequence numbers, bound timestamps, or predecessor commitment described for agent-run records.

D4.rationale: agentId is pervasive in the task/memory data model and on executor input; entries are not key-signed.

D5.rationale: Run-record redaction undocumented; PII stripping covers federation messages only, not run records.
